title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Acceptance and Application of Utility Payments
content:
# Acceptance of Utility Payments — Utility Services Program

**Rule.** Utility payments are accepted only while the account is active or in final billing. A payment is made in any lease-accepted instrument — the lease's certified-funds restriction applies here as well — or by application of the security deposit at final accounting, and it is applied to the account's oldest open bill line first.

## Elements of the rule

| Element | Under the rule |
|---|---|
| Account status that allows a payment | active or final billing, as the system record of the account shows |
| Instruments | any instrument the lease accepts; when the lease is restricted to certified funds, that restriction applies to utility payments as well |
| Deposit application | the security deposit may be applied at final accounting |
| Application | to the account's oldest open bill line first |

## Status check

| Account status | Utility payment |
|---|---|
| pending | not accepted |
| active | accepted |
| final billing | accepted |
| closed | not accepted |

*Example (hypothetical account):* an account in final billing carries two open lines, a March line and an April line. A payment on the account is applied to the March line first.
